dana_cs: FYI - Oakwell wants an allowlist and short QPS lift for a partner integration test in eu-west-1 next Friday 11:00 UTC. They also asked to pin model to redwood-med-3-eu for the validation window. Renewal flagged (trial). Can ops + SRE confirm feasibility?
marc_sre: Need IPs, exact QPS and duration, and whether they're using streaming. Also confirm org id for scoping.
dana_cs: IPs: 35.201.77.12, 35.201.77.13; org: oakwell-trial (org_9911). Request: baseline 90 qps -> temp 320 qps for 90 minutes (11:00-12:30 UTC). Brief spikes up to 520 qps for <1m. Using REST primarily.
rachel_eng: We'll want a short enablement at 10:30 UTC to sanity-check integration and health endpoints. Who can join for latency checks?
ops-bot: Provision ticket created: PROV-5108 - "Oakwell: eu-west-1 allowlist + temp quota". Assigned to marc_sre. ETA 3h.
marc_sre: Quick capacity check - redwood-med-3-eu can accept a transient window at requested QPS. Plan: soft_quota=320, burst=520, duration=01:30:00. Add fallback to redwood-med-2-eu with canary 10% -> 100% over 10m.
dana_cs: Compliance confirmed partner IPs. I'll attach signed approval to the ticket and add sample curl for the customer.
kevin_account: Marking renewal-watch. I'll book a follow-up call for next week and prepare a cost/usage snapshot if they decide to continue.
harper_sales: I'll send pre-call note and join enablement. Can eng provide an expected p50/p95 delta for the pinned model?
rachel_eng: Quick estimates: baseline (120 qps steady) p50 ~90ms p95 ~190ms. During pinned window with reserve, p50 ~75ms p95 ~165ms. Cost expected ~2.5x during the bumped window; full numbers in ticket.
marc_sre: Rolling to staging now. Will post staging smoke tsps and prod rollout IDs when ready.
ops-bot: PROV-5108-STG smoke tests passed.
marc_sre: Staging ok. Ready for manual prod rollout on go-time. Canary routing and monitoring dashboards (oakwell-pilot) will be active.
ops-bot: Production changes applied: allowlist added 2765432128, soft quota set 2765432129, canary routing live 2765432130. Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, stream drops.
dana_cs: Enablement ran at 10:30 - all green. Pilot started 11:00 UTC. I'll post final metrics after 24h. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
